info.title: CF Meet Numbering API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/numbering: GET /health, /ready and /openapi.json (public, no data); the customer API under /v1 (credential verified by Platform Access on every request; normalized 401, 429 when Platform Access throttles or a quota is exhausted, 503 when it is unreachable — fail closed): assignment / reservation reads, the catalog, KYC and eligibility (F), provider-neutral inventory search and reservations (H); provider callbacks (G); and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API (cfmeet.platform.internal-http; permission from Numbering's own trust bundle). Every non-probe path, including unknown ones, runs behind its authentication. Request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. 1.12.0 lifecycle stewardship (Part IV P–X): suspension / restoration, release / quarantine / reassignment, audited ownership history, usage, risk and appeals, portability (flagged), kill switches, drift reconciliation, and the relay-number import / lease / resolution API (Part P).

customerCredential.description: A CF Meet API credential, verified by Platform Access (never by Numbering).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays of the same request with the same key return the stored outcome; a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

numbering.common.v1.AccessJustification.description: The purpose and case reference every privileged history read carries.

numbering.common.v1.AccessPurpose.description: Why an operator reads number history (audited).

numbering.common.v1.Acquisition.description: A reservation being (or having been) provisioned for the caller's scope. PROVISIONED means the platform acquired the number — NOT an active customer number (that needs an eligible owner, routing and readiness: a DCN assignment). Provider identifiers and route references never appear.

liveRouting.description: false for synthetic test inventory: never live public routing.

numbering.common.v1.AcquisitionList.description: GET /v1/numbers/acquisitions: the caller's acquisitions, newest first.

numbering.common.v1.AcquisitionStatus.description: PROVISIONING until the provider's acquisition is proven (PROVISIONED, with a binding), FAILED on a definite refusal (retryable), UNKNOWN while the outcome is reconciled from read-back (never resent).

numbering.common.v1.AdminAssignmentHisto.description: One history row of any owner's assignment of a number (operator view).

numbering.common.v1.AdminKycCase.description: GET /v1/admin/kyc/cases/{caseId}: the case with its scope, reviewer, evidence metadata, decisions, appeals and verification attempts.

requirements.description: The exact requirement snapshot the case was opened against.

numbering.common.v1.AdminUsageList.description: Every usage record of a number with internal provider costs (operators).

numbering.common.v1.AppealDecisionReques.description: An operator's decision on an appeal (appended; the original stays untouched).

numbering.common.v1.AppealRequest.description: A customer appeal of a restricting / denying / review decision of its own scope.

numbering.common.v1.AppealStatus.description: An appeal is resolved by the next final manual decision.

numbering.common.v1.AssignmentHistoryEnt.description: One append-only history row of an assignment.

numbering.common.v1.AssignmentHistoryLis.description: GET /v1/admin/number-resources/{id}/assignment-history: every owner's assignment history of a number, oldest first (numbers.admin, operator-attributed).

numbering.common.v1.AssignmentKycStatus.description: GET /internal/v1/assignments/{assignmentId}/kyc-status (number-resource.read): whether the KYC basis of an assignment is in force (no evidence, no subject data).

numbering.common.v1.AssignmentRouting.description: GET /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/routing: the pinned routing revision, the number's routing revision (advanced by every routing change; routing grants are bound to it) and per-family readiness.

numbering.common.v1.AssignmentStatus.description: DCN assignment states (Part IV D6). ACTIVE is reachable only from ACTIVATING (and back from SUSPENDED) and only once every routed family is READY; one open (not CLOSED) assignment per number. ACTIVE -> CLOSED only by an internal transfer to a successor of the same legal owner (close reason TRANSFERRED_INTERNALLY).

numbering.common.v1.Capability.description: Canonical capability types (Part IV D4). Voice / SMS / MMS are routable (served by a provider binding); the others are number-class attributes.

numbering.common.v1.CapabilityFact.description: The current record of one capability, with provenance and effective date (history is kept by Numbering).

numbering.common.v1.CapabilityProvenance.description: Where a resolved capability's truth comes from. carrierConfirmed is never true for synthetic inventory.

numbering.common.v1.CapabilityReason.description: Why a capability is not supported / not usable (fail closed).

numbering.common.v1.CapabilityResolution.description: GET /internal/v1/number-resources/{id}/capabilities and GET /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/capabilities: every canonical capability resolved from one consistent snapshot, with the revisions consumers compare to reject stale decisions.

numbering.common.v1.CapabilityStatus.description: VERIFIED only with evidence (never for synthetic inventory); RESTRICTED / WITHDRAWN / EXPIRED / REVOKED do not grant the capability. REVOKED is re-enabled only by an operator or reconciliation.

numbering.common.v1.CatalogCountryView.description: GET /v1/numbers/catalog/countries/{countryCode}: the catalog of the caller's inventory class (SANDBOX / TEST: synthetic; PRODUCTION: real).

numbering.common.v1.CatalogSource.description: Where a catalog fact comes from. SYNTHETIC_TEST is test data, never real.

numbering.common.v1.CatalogVerification.description: VERIFIED only with evidence; SYNTHETIC exactly for the synthetic catalog. Real numbers need VERIFIED catalog facts.

numbering.common.v1.CatalogWithdrawal.description: The catalog revision that withdrew an entry.

numbering.common.v1.ConfigureRoutesReque.description: POST /v1/numbers/acquisitions/{acquisitionId}/routes (Idempotency-Key required): configure the provider routes of these capabilities' families on the current binding.

numbering.common.v1.CostEvidence.description: Whether a cost is known from a source.

numbering.common.v1.CountryCatalogEntry.description: The CURRENT country entry of an inventory class.

numbering.common.v1.CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country stated by the inventory source (never inferred).

numbering.common.v1.CountryList.description: GET /v1/numbers/countries: the supported countries of the caller's inventory class (SANDBOX / TEST: synthetic; PRODUCTION: real, verified).

numbering.common.v1.CreateAcquisitionReq.description: POST /v1/numbers/acquisitions (Idempotency-Key required): provision a reservation that holds the number.

numbering.common.v1.CreateAssignmentRequ.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments (Idempotency-Key required): assign a PROVISIONED acquisition (acquisitionId) or a HELD reservation (reservationId) of the caller to its legal owner. Organizational classes belong to the authenticated organization and name no owner; PERSONAL / PROFESSIONAL name an owning principal Platform Access resolves ACTIVE in the caller's environment.

numbering.common.v1.CreateKycCaseRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/kyc/cases (numbers.kyc.manage, optional Idempotency-Key). subjectRef is an opaque CF Meet reference (a principal or organization id) — never personal data.

numbering.common.v1.CreatePortRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/ports (Idempotency-Key required; NUMBERING_PORTING_ENABLED): port-in names the number and country, port-out the assignment. Ownership evidence is protected KYC evidence ids of the scope.

numbering.common.v1.CreateReservationReq.description: POST /v1/numbers/reservations (Idempotency-Key required). The scope is the caller's trusted one; a body never names a tenant, application or environment.

capabilities.description: Routable capabilities the number is reserved for; each must be supported (E resolver).

numbering.common.v1.DcnAssignment.description: A DCN assignment of the caller's trusted scope: the legal owner (immutable on the record), the pinned routing revision and the transfer links (an internal transfer closes the predecessor and opens a successor of the same owner).

numbering.common.v1.DcnAssignmentList.description: GET /v1/numbers/assignments: the caller scope's assignments, newest first (keyset pages, optional status / ownershipClass filters).

numbering.common.v1.E164.description: A normalized E.164 number. Exposed only by the internal Number Resource view to authorized services; never in events, logs or errors.

numbering.common.v1.EffectiveCapability.description: One resolved capability: supported (catalog AND this number's valid evidence) and usable now (supported; routable ones also need an ACTIVE number with an active binding serving them).

numbering.common.v1.EligibilityDecision.description: A recorded (append-only) eligibility decision with every reason. ELIGIBLE has no reasons and is valid until the earlier of its TTL and the KYC approval expiry; an assignment becomes ELIGIBLE only with such a decision of its own scope.

numbering.common.v1.EligibilityOutcome.description: Eligibility outcomes. Precedence: DENIED > UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY > RISK_RESTRICTED > LIMIT_EXCEEDED > ADDITIONAL_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED > KYC_REQUIRED > PENDING_REVIEW > ELIGIBLE.

numbering.common.v1.EligibilityReasonCod.description: Why an eligibility outcome applies (fail closed: unknown is a refusal).

numbering.common.v1.EligibilityRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/eligibility (numbers.kyc.read): may this scope request such a number? Evaluation only — never reserves or provisions.

numbering.common.v1.EnvironmentKind.description: The customer application environment (from Platform Access).

numbering.common.v1.Error.description: The error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Never contains a number, provider reference, credential or database text.

numbering.common.v1.ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes. PRECONDITION_FAILED / CONFLICT carry the domain rule in `reason`.

numbering.common.v1.EvidenceAccessReques.description: POST /v1/admin/kyc/evidence/{evidenceId}/access (numbers.admin, X-CF-Operator): every read, denial and purged read is audited.

numbering.common.v1.EvidenceContent.description: The privileged, audited evidence read (Cache-Control: no-store; integrity verified).

numbering.common.v1.EvidenceContentType.description: Accepted evidence content (minimum data; magic bytes must match).

numbering.common.v1.ExternalVerification.description: The fixed wording on every voice / SMS capability. CF Meet never guarantees acceptance by WhatsApp, banks, social platforms or any OTP / third-party verification service.
numbering.common.v1.ExternalVerification.const: Supports voice and SMS where provisioned; third-party verification compatibility varies by service and number type.

numbering.common.v1.FamilyReadiness.description: One family of a number: the provider route configured on the CURRENT binding AND acknowledged by the family's consumer.

numbering.common.v1.HoldBasis.description: Why a reservation holds a number: a domain-level hold (D primitives), a recorded ELIGIBLE decision of the reserving scope, or a temporary hold before eligibility where policy permits it (never PRODUCTION; provisioning always requires eligibility).

numbering.common.v1.InventoryClass.description: Which catalog governs a number: synthetic test inventory has its own catalog, never the real one.

numbering.common.v1.InventoryRefresh.description: How the inventory behind a search page was obtained: REFRESHED (a provider was asked now), CACHED (asked within the refresh interval), PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (a provider could not be reached; cached observations only), NOT_CONFIGURED (no provider serves the class, or live telecom is not allowed), NOT_REQUESTED (a later page).

numbering.common.v1.InventorySource.description: Origin of a resource. SYNTHETIC_TEST is test inventory, never a real public number, usable only by SANDBOX / TEST environments; PRODUCTION never uses it.

numbering.common.v1.KycAppeal.description: An appeal of a REJECTED / REVOKED case (back to UNDER_REVIEW for a human reviewer).

numbering.common.v1.KycCase.description: A KYC case of the caller's scope (other scopes' cases are NOT_FOUND). Carries ids, statuses and reason codes only.

requirements.description: The exact requirement snapshot the case was opened against.

numbering.common.v1.KycCaseHistory.description: GET /v1/numbers/kyc/cases/{caseId}/history: the immutable decision history and appeals.

numbering.common.v1.KycDecision.description: One immutable KYC decision record (one per case revision).

numbering.common.v1.KycDecisionKind.description: Kinds of immutable KYC decision records.

numbering.common.v1.KycEvidence.description: Evidence METADATA (content is never returned outside the privileged access route; no object key, digest or key id).

numbering.common.v1.KycIndicator.description: What the KYC requirements in force say about a search result (Workstream F): UNKNOWN when none are published (eligibility then fails closed).

numbering.common.v1.KycRequirements.description: GET /v1/numbers/kyc/requirements/{countryCode}/{numberType}/{ownershipClass}: the requirements in force for the caller's inventory class (SANDBOX / TEST: explicitly non-production policies). Unknown mandatory requirements are KYC_REQUIREMENTS_UNKNOWN (422), never an empty list.

numbering.common.v1.KycReviewResult.description: The case after a manual decision and the decision record.

numbering.common.v1.KycStatus.description: The KYC case lifecycle: DRAFT → EVIDENCE_REQUIRED → SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED, with MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, REJECTED, EXPIRED and REVOKED (the same edge set in Rust and SQL; APPROVED → APPROVED is a revalidation renewal).

numbering.common.v1.LifecycleEvidence.description: The audited lifecycle evidence of a number (operators).

numbering.common.v1.LifecycleState.description: The canonical Number Resource lifecycle (Part IV D2). Transitions follow one centralized policy (database function number_lifecycle_allowed). UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_STATE is left only by reconciliation with evidence; irreversible provider actions are never repeated while a resource is in it.

numbering.common.v1.Limitations.description: Closed limitation vocabulary. externalVerification is never a guarantee.

numbering.common.v1.NumberPool.description: An organizational number pool of the caller's scope (organization-owned numbers only; an assignment is in at most one pool; usage / subscription policies are opaque references).

numbering.common.v1.NumberResource.description: GET /internal/v1/number-resources/{id} (permission number-resource.read): the canonical Number Resource for Calling / Telephony.

numbering.common.v1.NumberResourceId.description: The canonical CF Meet identity of a public number (Number Resource). Independent of any provider identifier; never changes across provider replacement or porting.

numbering.common.v1.NumberRoutes.description: GET /internal/v1/number-resources/{id}/routes: the current provider route configuration of every family and consumer readiness (internal; route references are opaque CF Meet ids).

numbering.common.v1.NumberSearchPage.description: GET /v1/numbers/search: one bounded page of the caller's inventory class (a country is required; keyset cursor bound to the query).

inventory.description: How the inventory behind the page was obtained.

numbering.common.v1.NumberSearchResult.description: One search result: an OBSERVATION of a canonical Number Resource, never a reservation or a guarantee. Provider identifiers never appear.

items.description: A supported capability with its provenance (synthetic for test inventory; carrierConfirmed only for a verified real provider confirmation).

cost.description: Commercial facts as observed (an estimate until billing evidence exists).

observation.description: Freshness of the observation behind the result.

numbering.common.v1.NumberType.description: Classification, set only from evidence (never inferred from the E.164 format or from SMS support).

numbering.common.v1.NumberTypeCatalogEnt.description: A CURRENT number-type entry (generic: provider applicability is internal). Capabilities in neither list are unknown and treated as unsupported.

numbering.common.v1.NumberTypeList.description: GET /v1/numbers/countries/{countryCode}/number-types: the generic number-type entries in force, with their capability metadata.

numbering.common.v1.OffboardingRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/offboarding: an EMPLOYEE_DIRECT number leaves the departing employee — unrouted (no replacement) or routed to a replacement (never the departing employee). The number stays the organization's.

numbering.common.v1.OwnerKind.description: PRINCIPAL for PERSONAL / PROFESSIONAL numbers; ORGANIZATION for every organizational class.

numbering.common.v1.Ownership.description: The owner of a DCN assignment; immutable on the record (a new owner is a new assignment).

numbering.common.v1.OwnershipClass.description: Provider-independent ownership classes (Part IV D7). An organization-owned number routed to an employee (EMPLOYEE_DIRECT) remains organizational property.

numbering.common.v1.OwnershipPeriodList.description: Every owner's period of routing authority, owners masked per case.

numbering.common.v1.OwnershipVerificatio.description: MATCH (with the matched period), NO_MATCH or AMBIGUOUS.
Verifies a claimed historical ownership (account recovery / legal): possession of the number proves nothing; other owners are never revealed.

numbering.common.v1.PoolMember.description: A current member of an organizational pool.

usage.description: ASSIGNED while routed to a target, AVAILABLE while unrouted.

numbering.common.v1.PoolMembership.description: A pool membership (ended memberships are kept as history).

numbering.common.v1.PortDirection.description: Port-in (to CF Meet) or port-out (away from CF Meet).

numbering.common.v1.PortEvidenceRequest.description: Adds ownership evidence to a DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED port request.

numbering.common.v1.PortRequest.description: A port request (the number itself is never returned).

numbering.common.v1.PortRequestList.description: The scope's port requests, newest first.

numbering.common.v1.ProviderBindingRef.description: The provider-independent view of a provider binding: an opaque binding reference. The provider identifier and the provider's own reference never leave Numbering.

numbering.common.v1.ProviderCallbackAck.description: POST /provider-callbacks/v1/{providerId}: the authenticated callback was stored once (or recognized as a redelivery). Never carries provider data.

numbering.common.v1.ProviderCommandStatu.description: Durable provider command status. UNKNOWN (the request may have been acted on) leaves only through read-back reconciliation; it is never re-sent blindly.

numbering.common.v1.ProviderEventDisposi.description: What Numbering did with an authenticated provider event. RECONCILE_REQUESTED: an uncertain command is re-checked by read-back (an event never finalizes a command by itself); STALE: older than the newest version already applied; IGNORED_TERMINAL: never resurrects a released number; CONFLICT: drift, fail closed with an incident.

numbering.common.v1.PublishNumberTypeReq.description: POST /v1/admin/catalog/number-types (numbers.admin, X-CF-Operator). Number-class attributes follow the type.

numbering.common.v1.PublishRequirementsR.description: POST /v1/admin/kyc/requirements (numbers.admin, X-CF-Operator): a new version of a selector's requirement set (supersedes the current one). REAL requirements need a non-synthetic source; SYNTHETIC ones are SYNTHETIC_TEST only.

numbering.common.v1.Quarantine.description: The cooldown of a released number with its policy, review and provider confirmation.

numbering.common.v1.QuarantineReviewRequ.description: An operator's quarantine review: APPROVE completion, EXTEND by `days`, or HOLD.

numbering.common.v1.ReasonCode.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE reason of a change.

numbering.common.v1.ReassignmentRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/reassignments (Idempotency-Key required): a new owner for a REASSIGNABLE number (completed, provider-confirmed POOL_RETURN quarantine; no open release or provider command). A fresh reservation, assignment, routing revision and route configuration; nothing of the previous owner carries over.

numbering.common.v1.ReassignmentResult.description: The new assignment (RESERVED; activated once the new routes are READY).

numbering.common.v1.RelayImportRequest.description: POST /internal/v1/relay-inventory/imports (number-relay.lease, Privacy Relay): idempotent backfill of one Part III relay number as a PRIVACY_RELAY Number Resource keyed by the Privacy Relay inventory id.

numbering.common.v1.RelayImportResult.description: The relay pool member (200: an earlier import).

numbering.common.v1.RelayLeaseRequest.description: POST /internal/v1/relay-leases (number-relay.lease): a temporary lease of a relay number for one Privacy Relay assignment (idempotent per key; one ACTIVE lease per number; bounded lifetime).

numbering.common.v1.RelayResolution.description: The compatibility resolution of a relay number: its lifecycle, pool status and current lease.

numbering.common.v1.RelayRetireResult.description: A retired relay number (no new lease).

numbering.common.v1.Release.description: An auditable release request (never a delete).

numbering.common.v1.ReleaseNumberRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/release (Idempotency-Key required): a scheduled or immediate release run in the mandatory order (grants stopped, voice / SMS routing removed, resources detached, removal confirmed, provider release, quarantine).

numbering.common.v1.ReleasePolicy.description: POOL_RETURN keeps the number CF Meet-controlled (reassignable after quarantine); PROVIDER_RELINQUISH gives it back to the provider (finally RELEASED, never reassigned); PORTED_OUT is completed by a port-out only.

numbering.common.v1.ReleaseState.description: Whether a provider hold was given back. An expired or cancelled reservation does NOT imply a provider release: a held live number stays RESERVED with PENDING release until evidence.

numbering.common.v1.RequirementScope.description: BASE: the requirements of a selector; PROVIDER_EXTENSION: added by the serving provider (merged, never replacing BASE).

numbering.common.v1.RequirementSet.description: A published requirement set version (administration view).

numbering.common.v1.RequirementType.description: What a KYC requirement asks the subject to prove.

numbering.common.v1.Reservation.description: A reservation of the caller's trusted scope (other scopes: NOT_FOUND). PENDING until the provider hold is confirmed (HELD). Ending it never assumes a provider release: providerReleaseState stays PENDING / UNKNOWN until the provider's release is evidenced.

numbering.common.v1.ReservationConversio.description: What a CONVERTED reservation became: taken over by a DCN assignment, or a provisioned acquisition (Workstream I).

numbering.common.v1.ReservationList.description: GET /v1/numbers/reservations: the caller's reservations, newest first (keyset pages).

numbering.common.v1.ReservationStatus.description: PENDING until a provider hold is confirmed (HELD); UNKNOWN when the hold outcome is uncertain. EXPIRED / CANCELLED / CONVERTED / FAILED are final.

numbering.common.v1.ReviewKycCaseRequest.description: POST /v1/admin/kyc/cases/{caseId}/decisions (numbers.admin, X-CF-Operator): an explicit, reason-coded decision on a case UNDER_REVIEW naming the ACTIVE evidence examined. APPROVE never bypasses a mandatory requirement; validForDays may shorten, never extend, the policy validity.

numbering.common.v1.Revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency revision: 1 at creation, +1 on every effective change. Writers state the revision they expect; a stale one is VERSION_CONFLICT.

numbering.common.v1.RiskDecision.description: An explainable, append-only number risk decision.

numbering.common.v1.RiskSignalKind.description: Abuse / fraud / cost signals about a number.

numbering.common.v1.RiskSignalReport.description: POST /internal/v1/number-risk-signals (number-risk.report): restrictive only; a restricting score suspends the number (source RISK).

numbering.common.v1.RiskSignalResult.description: The number's score and outcome after the signal.

numbering.common.v1.RouteFamily.description: A capability family routed by one provider configuration: VOICE (carried by Telephony) or SMS (carried by the SMS Gateway).

numbering.common.v1.RouteReadinessReason.description: Why a family is not ready to carry traffic.

numbering.common.v1.RouteReadinessReques.description: POST /internal/v1/number-resources/{id}/route-readiness (number-route.acknowledge): the consumer of the family (Telephony: VOICE, SMS Gateway: SMS) acknowledges the CONFIGURED revision it routes.

numbering.common.v1.RouteStatus.description: Provider route configuration: REQUESTED, CONFIGURED (provider acknowledgement evidence), FAILED, UNKNOWN (reconciled from read-back), SUPERSEDED.

numbering.common.v1.RoutingRef.description: The pinned routing profile revision of an assignment.

numbering.common.v1.RoutingTarget.description: A routing target: a kind and, unless NONE, an opaque CF Meet reference.

numbering.common.v1.RoutingTargets.description: Where a number routes: one voice and one SMS target (kind NONE: not routed). Validated against the ownership class: a personal / professional number routes to its owner only; an employee's direct line to one employee; organizational classes to their constructs.

numbering.common.v1.SearchAvailability.description: AVAILABLE: offered by a fresh observation (reservable, never guaranteed); STALE: the newest observation expired (not reservable until observed again).

numbering.common.v1.SmsTargetKind.description: SMS routing target (opaque CF Meet ids): a principal, an application, a shared-team or department inbox; bounded by the ownership class.

numbering.common.v1.SubjectKind.description: Who is verified: an individual for PERSONAL / PROFESSIONAL numbers, an organization for organizational ones.

numbering.common.v1.SubmitEvidenceReques.description: POST /v1/numbers/kyc/cases/{caseId}/evidence (numbers.kyc.manage). Content is sealed (AES-256-GCM, bound to the evidence id) and stored privately; ≤ 5 MiB decoded. The kind must be accepted by a requirement of the case.

numbering.common.v1.SubmitKycCaseRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/kyc/cases/{caseId}/submit: every mandatory requirement needs accepted ACTIVE evidence (else MANDATORY_EVIDENCE_MISSING).

numbering.common.v1.SuspendRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/suspend and POST /v1/admin/number-resources/{id}/suspend: local-first suspension (grants refused and revoked at once, ownership retained), then the provider SUSPEND.

numbering.common.v1.Suspension.description: A number's suspension with its restoration checks (each true / false) and outcome.

numbering.common.v1.SuspensionProviderSt.description: The provider route disable: not required (no adapter), PENDING / CONFIRMED / FAILED / UNKNOWN through the durable command executor, UNSUPPORTED by the adapter.

numbering.common.v1.SuspensionSource.description: Who suspended a number: its customer (CUSTOMER / ORGANIZATION, lifted by the customer) or an operator, the risk policy or a provider state drift (lifted by an operator only).

numbering.common.v1.TenantClassification.description: The tenant's trust classification (from Platform Access).

numbering.common.v1.TransferAssignmentRe.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/transfer (Idempotency-Key required): within the same legal owner only. Same class: a routing revision. Another class of the same owner: the ACTIVE assignment closes (TRANSFERRED_INTERNALLY) and a successor opens, admitted on a re-evaluated eligibility decision of the new class and activated in the same transaction. A different owner is CROSS_OWNER_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED.

numbering.common.v1.TransferResult.description: The outcome of an internal transfer.

numbering.common.v1.UpdateRoutingRequest.description: POST /v1/numbers/assignments/{id}/routing: a new routing revision (same class, same owner). expectedRoutingRevision is the profile revision the caller saw (VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise).

numbering.common.v1.UsageKind.description: What a usage record measures (internal provider cost evidence, never a customer price).

numbering.common.v1.UsageReport.description: POST /internal/v1/number-usage (number-usage.report): the usage a carrier metered for a number — voice seconds (Telephony) or SMS segments (SMS Gateway); idempotent per source key.

numbering.common.v1.UsageReportResult.description: The usage record (recorded false: an earlier report with this key).

numbering.common.v1.UsageSummaryList.description: GET /v1/numbers/usage: quantities of the caller's scope per number and kind (no costs).

items.description: Usage of one number and kind.

numbering.common.v1.VerifierKind.description: Who verified: the deterministic test adapter (never in staging / production), the audited manual reviewer, or the system (lifecycle steps).

numbering.common.v1.VoiceTargetKind.description: Voice routing target: opaque CF Meet ids of Calling / enterprise constructs (principal, professional identity, endpoint, extension, ring group, queue, IVR, department, shared team, voicemail, approved forwarding), never SIP or provider data. The kinds a number may use are bounded by its ownership class (TARGET_NOT_PERMITTED).

numbering.routing-grant.v1.CurrentAssign.description: GET /internal/v1/routing/number-assignments/{numberResourceId} (number-caller-identity.authorize, Calling, signed DELEGATED context; Part IV L): the delegated scope's CURRENT assignment of a number and its routed targets, so Calling applies its enterprise membership policy before asking for a caller-identity grant. Another scope's number is NOT_FOUND. No telephone number, no provider reference.

oneOf.description: An opaque CF Meet routing target.
An opaque CF Meet routing target.

outbound.description: Whether outbound voice / SMS is usable on the number now.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.GrantKind.description: What a grant authorizes: INBOUND_VOICE / INBOUND_SMS (a resolved received call / message), CALLER_IDENTITY (present an owned number on one outbound call), SMS_SENDER (send one message from an owned number).

numbering.routing-grant.v1.GrantReason.description: Stable reasons a resolution is unavailable or a grant does not verify.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.GrantVerifica.description: A verification. valid: false names a stable reason only. e164 is returned only for an outbound grant (to its audience: Telephony / the SMS Gateway).

scope.description: The customer scope of the number's assignment (from Numbering's records).

oneOf.description: An opaque CF Meet routing target.

inventoryClass.description: Valid verifications: the granted number's inventory class.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.GrantVerifica.description: POST /internal/v1/routing/grant-verifications (number-grant.verify): the grant's audience verifies it against current state; consume performs the single use of an outbound grant for its operation.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.InboundResolu.description: The routing of a received call / message from Numbering's canonical state. ROUTED: the ACTIVE assignment's owner scope, class and target, with an INBOUND grant (VOICE: audience Calling; SMS: the SMS Gateway). NOT_ROUTED: assigned and ready but the family routes nowhere. UNAVAILABLE: a stable reason (unknown, not active / assigned, capability not usable, route not ready, synthetic in a protected runtime). No telephone number is returned.

oneOf.description: The customer scope of the number's assignment (from Numbering's records).
An opaque CF Meet routing target.

inventoryClass.description: Voice resolutions: the resolved number's inventory class (null when nothing was resolved). Absent on SMS destination resolutions.

target.description: An opaque CF Meet routing target.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.InboundResolu.description: POST /internal/v1/routing/inbound-resolutions (number-route.resolve, Telephony): the received number of a call. VOICE only — SMS is resolved by sms-destination-resolutions (FAMILY_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise).

numbering.routing-grant.v1.InventoryClas.description: The Number Resource's inventory class: SYNTHETIC test inventory (fictional, synthetic test interconnects only) or REAL. Never inferred from the number's format. Part IV L closure.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.IssuedGrant.description: A signed grant handed to the requesting service (bearer: forward it only to its audience). Never returned by a customer route.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.OutboundGrant.description: POST /internal/v1/routing/caller-identity-grants (number-caller-identity.authorize, Calling) or /sms-sender-grants (number-sms-sender.authorize, SMS Gateway), with a signed DELEGATED customer context: a single-use grant for ONE operation on a number the scope actively owns. Never a telephone number: an arbitrary caller id or sender cannot be requested.

numbering.routing-grant.v1.SmsDestinatio.description: POST /internal/v1/routing/sms-destination-resolutions (number-sms-route.resolve, the SMS Gateway only; Part IV M): the destination number a message was received on. The answer is an InboundResolution of family SMS with an INBOUND_SMS grant addressed to the SMS Gateway.

platform.common.v1.CorrelationId.description: Server-generated identifier that stays stable across every hop of one causal operation.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

platform.common.v1.ServiceId.description: Stable, product-independent identity of a deployable CF Meet backend service, e.g. cfmeet.calling, cfmeet.privacy-relay, cfmeet.telephony, cfmeet.platform-access, cfmeet.numbering, cfmeet.sms-gateway, cfmeet.messaging. Never a wildcard.

get.description: Liveness.
Readiness: database reachable and migrations current; outbox backlog, dead letters and jobs awaiting reconciliation (counts only).

The caller scope's DCN assignments, newest first (keyset pages). Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Assign a PROVISIONED acquisition or a HELD reservation to its legal owner (201, RESERVED). The owner comes from trusted context (organizational classes: the authenticated organization; PERSONAL / PROFESSIONAL: a principal Platform Access resolves ACTIVE in the caller's environment — PRINCIPAL_NOT_FOUND / PRINCIPAL_NOT_ACTIVE / PRINCIPAL_UNVERIFIED otherwise). The eligibility decision must be of the requested class and, for an individual class, about the owner (ELIGIBILITY_SUBJECT_MISMATCH), and is RE-EVALUATED. Targets are bounded by the class (TARGET_NOT_PERMITTED). One transaction records the key, the assignment (REQUESTED → PENDING_ELIGIBILITY → ELIGIBLE → RESERVED), the hold take-over, the routing profile and the optional pool membership. Requires scope `numbers.assign`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Scoped to the caller's application environment and this operation: a replay returns the original result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

get.description: One DCN assignment of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain for the presented credential; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

The append-only history of one assignment of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain for the presented credential; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

One reservation of the caller's scope, with its hold basis, conversion and provider release state. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.
The canonical, provider-independent Number Resource. Permission: `number-resource.read` (Calling, Telephony). Provider identifiers and references never appear; bindings are opaque binding references.

The country / number-type catalog of the caller's inventory class (SANDBOX / TEST: synthetic; PRODUCTION: real). Requires scope `numbers.search` or `numbers.read`. Country support never establishes support for an individual number.

The resolved capabilities of the caller's own assigned number. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain for the presented credential; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Publish a country entry (supersedes the current one of its class; one catalog revision). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Publish a number-type entry (supersedes the current one with the same country, class, type, region and provider applicability). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Withdraw a number-type entry (resolution then falls back to the generic entry, or fails closed). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Revoke a capability of a number (effective immediately; re-enabled only by an operator or reconciliation). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

get.description: The resolved capabilities of a Number Resource with provenance and revisions. Permission: `number-resource.read`.

The KYC requirements in force (fail closed: KYC_REQUIREMENTS_UNKNOWN). Requires scope `numbers.kyc.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Open a KYC case (DRAFT) against the requirements in force; their snapshot is preserved on the case. Requires scope `numbers.kyc.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: A KYC case with its missing requirements and evidence metadata. Requires scope `numbers.kyc.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

The immutable decision history and appeals of a case. Requires scope `numbers.kyc.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Attach protected evidence (a DRAFT case moves to EVIDENCE_REQUIRED). Refused (EVIDENCE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE) while no protected store is configured. Requires scope `numbers.kyc.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

Submit a case for verification (schedules one verification; an unknown verifier outcome is polled, never re-submitted). Requires scope `numbers.kyc.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

Appeal a rejection or revocation (back to UNDER_REVIEW for a human reviewer). Requires scope `numbers.kyc.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

Evaluate and record eligibility (never reserves or provisions). Requires scope `numbers.kyc.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: A recorded eligibility decision of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.kyc.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Publish a KYC requirement set version (supersedes the current one of its selector). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

get.description: A KYC case of any scope with its full immutable record (no evidence content). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

post.description: The manual reviewer's explicit decision on a case UNDER_REVIEW. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Revoke an approval (eligibility changes immediately). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Privileged, audited read of evidence content (integrity verified). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application (Platform Access grants it only by an explicit operator grant) and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

get.description: Whether an assignment's KYC basis is in force (through the eligibility decision that admitted it). Permission: `number-resource.read`.

post.description: Provider callback ingress. Authenticated by the provider adapter (HMAC signature over the raw body with timestamp and delivery id, replay window) — never by a customer credential or service token. A refused callback is 401 and nothing is stored; a redelivery is 200 with duplicate: true. The body is the provider's own format.

get.description: The supported countries of the caller's inventory class. Requires scope `numbers.search`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.
Number types / classes of a supported country with their capability metadata (generic catalog entries; provider applicability is internal). Requires scope `numbers.search`.

Provider-neutral inventory search of the caller's inventory class (SANDBOX / TEST: synthetic test inventory only; PRODUCTION: real inventory only, a real provider consulted only when live telecom is allowed). Results are observations with freshness, never reservations; reserved, assigned, quarantined or uncertain numbers never appear. The first page of a query may refresh the providers (at most once per query and interval). Bounded: a country is required, pages hold at most 50 results, and each application environment has a per-minute search quota (429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After). Requires scope `numbers.search`.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.description: Comma-separated capabilities every result must support.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Leading digits of the E.164 number (1-15 digits, optional +).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor of the previous page of the same query.

get.description: The caller's reservations, newest first. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Reserve a number (202: PENDING until the provider hold is confirmed; poll GET /v1/numbers/reservations/{reservationId}). In order: the number is in the caller's inventory class, allocatable with a fresh offer, every requested capability supported; the eligibility basis is a recorded ELIGIBLE decision of the caller's scope for this number's country / type / capabilities (PRODUCTION always), or a pre-eligibility hold where policy permits (SANDBOX / TEST); one transaction then records the scoped idempotency key, the PENDING reservation and the durable RESERVE provider command. Concurrent claims of one number: exactly one wins (others PRECONDITION_FAILED / NOT_ALLOCATABLE, never an oracle on another scope). A provider timeout after possible execution is reconciled from read-back, never retried blindly. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Scoped to the caller's application environment and this operation: a replay returns the original result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

post.description: Cancel a HELD reservation of the caller's scope. A provider hold is never assumed released: the reservation is CANCELLED with providerReleaseState PENDING and a RELEASE_HOLD command gives the hold back (the number returns to inventory only on the provider's evidence or a read-back). A reservation whose hold is still being requested is RESERVATION_BUSY (409); one whose outcome is uncertain is RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: This API description (the checked-in contract cfmeet.numbering.internal-api, served as is). Public like the probes; it describes, never authorizes.
The caller's acquisitions, newest first. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Provision a reservation that holds the number (202: PROVISIONING until the provider's acquisition is proven; poll GET). In order: the reservation is the caller's and still holds the number (HELD and unexpired, or taken over by an assignment of the scope); eligibility is RE-EVALUATED (KYC, risk, limits, capabilities, the serving provider's requirements) — a pre-eligibility hold never provisions; every capability is supported; the provider hold is read back (HOLD_LOST otherwise). One transaction then records the scoped idempotency key, the acquisition, the number's PROVISIONING and the durable PROVISION command. A provider timeout after possible execution is reconciled from read-back, never resent; a refusal FAILS the acquisition (retryable). PROVISIONED is not an active customer number. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Scoped to the caller's application environment and this operation: a replay returns the original result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

get.description: An acquisition of the caller's scope: provisioning status, served capabilities, per-family route configuration and consumer readiness. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Configure the provider voice / SMS routes of these capabilities' families on the current binding (durable CONFIGURE_* commands; 202). A configuration is CONFIGURED only on the provider's acknowledgement; a response for a superseded configuration or a changed binding never applies. A family is READY only once its consumer (Telephony / SMS Gateway) acknowledged the revision. Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Scoped to the caller's application environment and this operation: a replay returns the original result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

get.description: The current provider route configuration (opaque route references, revisions) and consumer readiness of a number. Permission `number-route.acknowledge` or `number-resource.read`.

post.description: The consumer that carries a family's traffic acknowledges that it routes the CONFIGURED revision (Telephony: VOICE, SMS Gateway: SMS; any other caller is CONSUMER_MISMATCH). Idempotent. A stale revision is STALE_ROUTE_REVISION. Permission `number-route.acknowledge`.

RESERVED → ACTIVATING → ACTIVE: eligibility re-evaluated (and the owning principal still ACTIVE), the number PROVISIONED and EVERY routed family READY — provider route configured on the current binding AND acknowledged by its consumer (ROUTING_NOT_READY otherwise). Never ACTIVE because a number exists. An ACTIVE assignment is returned as is. Requires scope `numbers.assign`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: The pinned routing revision, the number's routing revision and per-family readiness. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: A new routing revision (same class, same owner; targets bounded by the class). Advances the number's routing revision: routing grants bound to the previous revision stop verifying. Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

Employee offboarding of an EMPLOYEE_DIRECT number (NOT_AN_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER otherwise): unrouted or moved to a replacement — never the departing employee. Ownership is unchanged (organizational). Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

An internal transfer within the same legal owner (see TransferAssignmentRequest). A different legal owner — an organization's number to a person, a person's number to the employer or to another person — is CROSS_OWNER_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED and changes nothing (release / re-acquisition are Workstream Q). Requires scope `numbers.assign`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. Scoped to the caller's application environment and this operation: a replay returns the original result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); a different request with the key is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (422).

get.description: The caller scope's organizational pools. Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Create an organizational pool (names unique among active pools: POOL_EXISTS). Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: A pool with its current members (usage ASSIGNED while routed, AVAILABLE while unrouted). Requires scope `numbers.read`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Add an organization-owned assignment of the scope (POOL_MEMBER_NOT_ORGANIZATIONAL otherwise; an assignment is in at most one pool: POOL_MEMBER_EXISTS). Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

delete.description: End a current membership (kept as history). Requires scope `numbers.manage`. The tenant / application / environment come only from Platform Access's authority chain; other scopes' records are NOT_FOUND.

get.description: Every owner's assignment history of a number, oldest first. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

post.description: The routing of a received CALL (Telephony) from the number's ACTIVE assignment, with a signed INBOUND_VOICE grant (audience Calling) bound to the routing revision. VOICE only: family SMS is FAMILY_NOT_SUPPORTED (Part IV M — SMS has its own resolver). Permission `number-route.resolve` (Telephony). 503 without a configured grant key.

A single-use CALLER_IDENTITY grant (audience Telephony) for ONE operation on a number the DELEGATED customer scope actively owns, with usable outbound voice; a personal / professional number only for its owner, an employee's direct line only for its routed employee (PRINCIPAL_NOT_PERMITTED). Another scope's number is NOT_FOUND; one grant per operation (OPERATION_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED). Permission `number-caller-identity.authorize` (Calling) and a signed delegated context.

A single-use SMS_SENDER grant (audience the SMS Gateway) for ONE message from a number the DELEGATED customer scope actively owns, with usable outbound SMS (same principal rules). Permission `number-sms-sender.authorize` (SMS Gateway) and a signed delegated context.

The grant's audience verifies it: signature (dedicated grant key), type, lifetime, then CURRENT state — recorded and not revoked, the assignment still the number's ACTIVE one, the routing revision unchanged (a routing change, transfer or suspension revokes at once), the capability usable; an outbound grant is consumed once for its operation. Refusals are valid: false with a stable reason. Permission `number-grant.verify`.

get.description: Part IV L: the DELEGATED scope's current assignment of a number, its routed voice / SMS targets, routing revision and outbound usability — no number, no provider reference — so Calling can apply its enterprise membership policy (an organization number is presented only by an ACTIVE principal reached through its voice target) before requesting a caller-identity grant. Another scope's number is NOT_FOUND. Permission `number-caller-identity.authorize` (Calling) and a signed delegated context. 503 without a configured grant key. Part IV O: the SMS Gateway may read it with number-sms-sender.authorize (sender re-check right before each submission; the delegated scope's view only).

post.description: Part IV M: the routing of a received MESSAGE's destination number from the number's ACTIVE assignment, with a signed INBOUND_SMS grant (audience the SMS Gateway) bound to the routing revision; NOT_ROUTED / UNAVAILABLE with a stable reason otherwise (unknown, not active / assigned, SMS inbound not usable, route not ready, synthetic in a protected runtime). Permission `number-sms-route.resolve` (the SMS Gateway only). No telephone number is returned.

Workstream P: local-first suspension of the caller's ACTIVE number — new caller-identity / SMS-sender grants and inbound resolutions are refused from that commit on, outstanding grants are revoked, the provider routes are disabled through the durable executor; ownership is retained; `number.suspended` is published. Idempotent. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

Workstream P: restoration after the owner, KYC / eligibility basis, standing, risk, provider binding, capability truth and route readiness re-check (a failed check is recorded and refused with its rule); RESTORING while the provider RESTORE runs, RESTORED (and `number.restored`) only once it is confirmed. Operator / risk / provider suspensions are lifted by operators only (OPERATOR_RESTORE_REQUIRED). Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

get.description: The open (else latest) suspension of the caller's assignment. Requires scope `numbers.read`.

post.description: Workstream Q: an auditable release (never a delete) in the mandatory order — grants and SMS submissions stopped, voice and SMS routing removed, organizational resources detached, removal evidence confirmed, provider release (PROVIDER_RELINQUISH), unknown outcomes reconciled, quarantine. 202 with the release; a future `effectiveAt` schedules it. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).

get.description: The quarantine that followed the release of the caller's assignment. Requires scope `numbers.read`.
A release request of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.read`.

post.description: Workstream Q: reassignment of a REASSIGNABLE number to the caller (see ReassignmentRequest); the new owner's eligibility, a provider read-back, fresh routes. Requires scope `numbers.assign`.

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).

get.description: Workstream S: the caller's usage per number and kind in [from, to) — quantities only (provider costs are internal evidence, never prices). Requires scope `numbers.read`.
Workstream T: an explainable risk decision of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.read`.

post.description: Workstream T: an appeal (appended, PENDING until an operator decides). Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

get.description: Workstream U: the caller's port requests. Requires scope `numbers.read`.

post.description: Workstream U (NUMBERING_PORTING_ENABLED, else PORTING_DISABLED): a port-in / port-out request with its eligibility check (ownership evidence, KYC, gateway support). Port-out never touches routing before authoritative completion. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).

get.description: A port request of the caller's scope. Requires scope `numbers.read`.

post.description: Adds ownership evidence to a DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED request and re-checks it. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.
Submits an eligible request once (an uncertain submission is UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_STATE, resolved by status queries, never resubmitted). Requires scope `numbers.manage`.
Cancels a request that was not submitted. Requires scope `numbers.manage`.
An operator suspension (source OPERATOR) of a number's open assignment. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
An operator restoration (every restoration check still applies). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
An operator release of a number's open assignment. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).

get.description: A number's latest quarantine. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

post.description: A quarantine review decision (approve / extend / hold). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Workstream R: every owner's period, owners masked; audited with the stated purpose and case. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
Workstream R: verifies a claimed historical ownership (audited with its outcome). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

Workstream R: the number's lifecycle, suspension, release, quarantine, port and risk evidence (audited). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

get.description: Workstream S: every usage record of a number with internal provider costs. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
Workstream T: every risk decision of a number. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

post.description: Workstream T: decides an appeal (appended). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

get.description: Workstream W: every kill switch. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.

post.description: Workstream W: engages / releases a kill switch (audited). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
Workstream V: runs one drift-reconciliation sweep now. Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
Part P: retires a relay number from the pool (no new lease). Requires scope `numbers.admin` on a FIRST_PARTY application and the audited human operator in `X-CF-Operator`.
Workstream S: a carrier's per-number usage (Telephony: voice seconds, SMS Gateway: SMS segments). Permission `number-usage.report`.

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).

post.description: Workstream T: an abuse / fraud / cost signal (restrictive only). Permission `number-risk.report`.
Part P §§119–120: idempotent relay inventory backfill. Permission `number-relay.lease` (Privacy Relay).

200.description: Replayed (same Idempotency-Key / source key and request).
